decision.observation: Red alert is off. Two duplicants remain: one beside the pod, one on the lower-right ledge. The Manual Generator scaffold sits above the platform's right end (~0.62,0.31) awaiting construction. Oxygen 17%; oxylite down to 835 g.
decision.hypothesis: Duplicants will haul the reserved copper ore and build the generator; afterward a Wire to the diffuser will complete the power chain.
decision.memory: Power chain: generator (200 kg metal ore committed) → wire → diffuser (needs algae 550 g/s). Available copper 253.4 kg; algae 1094.7 kg.
